findings.finding: Per-call sealing checked only listed file hashes and could miss newly added runtime/harness files.
findings.resolution: Every dispatch now revalidates the exact reviewed candidate/harness manifest and exact baseline/candidate file sets; start/end and post-run checks compare the complete dependency set. Windows path separators are normalized; only the existing top-level node_modules junction is allowed.
findings.validation: Offline regression verifies additions/deletions/content changes and compares actual full frozen runtime/dependency manifests.

findings.finding: Audit exporter expected gold.common while this fresh suite stores top-level adjudication.
findings.resolution: Exporter falls back to top-level adjudication/notForExecutor, preserving the missing-capability and real-execution distinction in the review packet.

scope: outer transport and shared authorization ledger
limitations: This is an independent model-agent static/offline preflight review, not a human review or evidence of live-model readiness.

The subscribed CLI has opaque request wrapping and no enforced output cap. Admission reserves UTF-8 input bytes plus at least 128000 output tokens and 16384 wrapper tokens; actual reported usage is authoritative. Unknown/conflicting usage or measured overage halts dispatch.
A stopped budget or failed initial acceptance may leave later branches/revisions unattempted. Such cases remain incomplete; no automatic rerun or budget renewal is authorized.

Both revision cases use normal user-selected changes between already documented alternatives. The evaluator preserves the production job.goal created from the initial task and does not overwrite it after updateTask/revise. Any stale-goal rejection is product/lifecycle behavior to report, not to bypass.
Gold and authoring script bytes are hashed for integrity only. The live executor uses suite inputs and does not import gold labels or execute the authoring script.

Mechanism execution requires actual phase-local receipts and transitions. A correct answer, copied receipt, internal replay or final snapshot alone is insufficient evidence of an earlier explicit action.
Six synthetic pairs and residual protocol cues limit statistical claims and blinding. Capability absence alone is not hallucination.

R6-F02 gold contains the nonfunctional metadata spelling businessAnswerDoesNotProvesExecution; descriptive mechanism requirements and top-level adjudication remain authoritative. Sealed samples were preserved unchanged.
No production installation, user workspace mutation, external business action, main evaluation, secondary model, or additional live probe is authorized by this review.
